independent_review.text:
# Independent post-sandbox producer transition review

The four-file patch SHA-256 `c6b14a2b9d3d1ee210777552b76673492a2f8a304722b75b3cab4d2013ddc2eb` is supported as a bounded source-transition candidate, not a live inherited admission. All four canonical preimage hashes matched; strict apply succeeded, and independently applying to copied files produced all four recorded afterimage hashes. The overlay helper pin matches the landed sandboxed browser helper. All 42 current table checker source-member pins match candidate bytes. The table producer captures 41 of those members before and after; `scripts/upstream-packed-run-evidence.mjs` is checked directly by the validator rather than included in the producer snapshot. The newly added four legacy-core paths are in both checker pins and the producer's before/after source snapshot.

The table-column probe replaces the direct dump-dom process with the owned Chromium helper, polls the actual result element, parses text content and retains the existing observations and negative comparisons. Its previous direct-launch probe log records a timeout, without establishing why. The retained final CDP report SHA-256 `3574bf2bc6f81f6e5a3e6f1b2341d864ea2c0b44d1b155286dd7f86cdfa2ba67` reports three models, 288 native class cases and six rejected test mutations; it explicitly does not qualify a complete table. The CDP test was not rerun by this reviewer.

The retained source controls are fixture-only: five overlay subjects and fixture faults, three table subjects with 17 observation mutations, and six source-file mutations rejected before the absent packed-run gate. They do not execute the actual new live packed producer or establish current run admission. The fixed producer/checker still requires a genuine same-artifact packed run, pinned toolchain and fresh browser execution; source hash updates do not requalify historical receipts.

The separate Karma transition map SHA-256 `f7f6fc90f72f18b99886b3858be4e9079890c48b741b20dbfc2137d62573a632` preserves the exact prior historical-behavior object for all 14 ledger subjects. Each has 8–11 stale source members, so changing the Karma hash alone cannot requalify these proofs. Their source reviews and fresh coordinated artifact suite remain open. No canonical files were changed and no full matrix, security, or release claim is made.
